mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_project (project_code, project_name, description, owner_id, status, public_visible, category, cover_media_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{publicVisible}, #{category}, #{coverMediaId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
INSERT INTO lab_project_member (project_id, user_id, project_role, joined_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{projectRole}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN lab_project_member current_member ON current_member.project_id = p.id AND current_member.user_id = #{userId}

sql.if: AND (p.project_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: p.id, p.project_code AS code, p.project_name AS name, p.description AS summary, p.category, p.status, NULL AS coverUrl, current_member.project_role AS myRole, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_project_member member_count WHERE member_count.project_id = p.id) AS memberCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_project p
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT pm.user_id AS userId, u.member_id AS memberId, u.username AS name, pm.project_role AS projectRole, pm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM lab_project_member pm INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = pm.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pm.project_role = 'OWNER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pm.joined_at ASC, pm.user_id ASC
